signal: Stampli raised a $61M Series D led by Blackstone (total $148M), expanding its AI-powered AP automation across 1,800+ businesses.

email.body1:
Hannah, saw Stampli close its $61M Series D led by Blackstone, with the AP platform now across 1,800-plus businesses.

After a raise like that, the strategic account list usually grows faster than the time you have to research and write personal first touches. Our AI SDR handles the research, writing, and follow-up so reps spend time in conversations, not the inbox: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I had our AI SDR draft 3 personalized emails to three of your top strategic accounts. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through them?
email.body2:
Hannah, quick follow-up.

At strategic scale, the hard part is not finding accounts, it is touching every one with research-backed, personalized outreach before they go cold. Multi-channel sequencing lifts responses 287% over single channel, but only if every account actually gets worked.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I would change, and how the AI SDR runs email and LinkedIn so your follow-up never slips.
email.body3:
Hannah, last bit of proof.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to the CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to other strategic SDR teams. Want to grab time so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Hannah, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If reducing follow-up load and speeding up response is not a focus this quarter, no problem at all. Strategic prospecting is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a strategic SDR motion? I will tailor it to Stampli either way.
